fields.statement: Verified at 48276c56. docs/rex-upstream/notification-banner.md is committed. Its Rex server version matches rex version run on the VM (0.0.1793645657-gd018d2, commit d018d2de). Its OSC 7501 bytes match the passing session-run-blocked-notice testscript (go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/session-run-blocked-notice -count=1: ok), and end with ST (ESC \), which rexRecord in internal/api/run.go writes (attempt-1 finding f2 fixed). It holds a rex events --json program_status_changed record for Claude Code 2.1.316 blocked on a permission prompt on the VM (finding f1 fixed), plus the VM host setup, the symptom (chime, no banner) and blank OWNER Mac fields: app version, whether a banner shows, focus and notification permission. rhiza show rex-banner-report-ready --json gives an open question written in a record-kind change set (apply --record). Its statement names the doc and asks the owner to check the Mac, fill the fields and file with Rex if the banner is still missing. make self-check: ok. The commit changes no Go files. make check's go test hit only timing and timeout failures (TestReadBudget, slice TestBudget, a plan-workflow timeout) under VM load averages of 13 to 17, none in code this leaf touches.
